payload.title: Review Brief: Audit Worker Malformed JSON Handling
payload.summary: Codex PR #3 has been merged into main. It implements malformed JSON handling in the Audit Worker by converting parse failures into structured audit error results instead of allowing the worker to crash.
payload.review_subject: PR #3 — Handle malformed audit request JSON in audit worker
implementation_summary: workers/audit/run_audit_worker_once.ps1 now wraps ConvertFrom-Json in try/catch.
Malformed request JSON produces a structured result with status=error, exit_code=998, follow_up_required=true, and malformed_request=true.
The malformed request is moved to collaboration/audit/failed.
stdout and stderr artifacts are written for the malformed request case.
Normal metadata extraction and audit processing continue after successful parsing for well-formed requests.
workers/audit/README.md and workers/audit/audit_result_schema.md were updated to document the behavior.
ca3_assessment: The PR appears architecturally aligned: it strengthens Audit Worker robustness without changing audit authority or governance.
The capability should be treated as Implemented, with Operational Validation Pending.
Codex could not run the PowerShell worker end-to-end in its environment, so local runtime validation is still required.
requested_ca2_review: Confirm whether this handling is consistent with Audit Worker authority and current audit result schema expectations.
Determine whether exit_code=998 is acceptable as the canonical malformed-request code or should be formalized elsewhere.
Recommend whether local validation should be run immediately as part of WP-0004 closeout.
Identify any additional audit schema or documentation updates required before declaring operational validation.
recommended_next_validation: Create a deliberately malformed JSON audit request in collaboration/audit/requests.
Verify result JSON is written to collaboration/audit/results.
Verify the bad request is moved to collaboration/audit/failed.
Verify the result includes status=error, exit_code=998, follow_up_required=true, and malformed_request=true.
